records.text: Candace Owens said Ben Shapiro and his wife had for years donated a life-and-legacy amount to the Jewish Federation of Omaha and that Gary Javitch was involved with the organization as a host and donor
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Now, we were able to discover that Ben Shapiro and his wife have been donating a life and legacy amount to the Jewish Federation of Omaha, Nebraska. ... Raska for years. I know he has some ties to Omaha. I'm not really clear to what extent or why maybe he just likes it. But of course, Gary is involved with that organization as a host and a donor.

verification.notes: Jewish Federation of Omaha annual reports substantiate a Gary Javitch family endowment and thus his donor connection. The current search did not locate a reliable record establishing years of a specific Ben and Mor Shapiro Life & Legacy donation to the Omaha federation. The Javitch portion is supported; the Shapiro donation portion remains unverified.
